nodes.label: code-audit Artifact Schema v2.2
nodes.rationale: Adds origin, rule_changes, stale, verdict_reason, resolved base, rules source, and per-origin stats strictly as additive fields so 2.1 artifacts remain readable as not-assessed by scripts/render_report.py.

nodes.label: Verdict Reason and Cross-Platform Reviewer Receipt Contract
nodes.norm_label: verdict reason and cross-platform reviewer receipt contract
nodes.rationale: Ensures every Claude, Codex, and Cursor reviewer receipt reports per-origin counts, rule changes, resolved base, and stale state, and requires a one-sentence verdict reason naming deciding findings so orchestrators reject stale clearances.

nodes.label: scripts/validate_repo.py (Stdlib Repo Validator)
nodes.rationale: Uses Python 3.11+ standard library only (json, tomllib, pathlib, subprocess for bash -n) with a small flat-frontmatter parser so contributors need no third-party dependencies while checking catalogs, skill directories, agent variants/descriptions/preloads, mods, and scripts in one read-only run.

nodes.label: Proposal: Review Origin and Base Rules
nodes.norm_label: proposal: review origin and base rules
nodes.rationale: Closes integrity gaps in craft:code-audit and craft:structure-review where a change could edit its own governing rules, pre-existing defects were handled inconsistently, and reviews were not bound to a specific commit or working-tree state.

nodes.label: Proposal: Verification Infrastructure
nodes.rationale: Automates structural repo checks via scripts/validate_repo.py and a tracked project verify skill, upgrades architecture-baseline with a real-run verify skill, pre-push gate tier, integration lane deselection, and trailer prompt, and adds configurable modes to agent-write-guard.

nodes.label: Proposal: Audit in Build Loop
nodes.rationale: Integrates code-auditor into flow:orchestrate closing review alongside structure-reviewer without overlapping concerns, adding signal-gated offers, four-dimension focus, and incremental code-audit re-reviews.

nodes.label: Proposal: Build Loop Verification
nodes.rationale: Bounds failing build and review loops, carries round history forward, enforces real checks across all worker platforms, introduces safe close runs and opt-in git verification trailers, protects gate configuration, and adds property, differential, and flaky-test rules.

nodes.label: Proposal: Standards Verification Rules
nodes.rationale: Upgrades data:sql-data-analysis with multiplicity-preserving rewrite comparisons and idempotency checks, and upgrades craft:python-engineering-standards with property-based testing, flaky-test prohibition, three-tier local/CI checks, and integration/stress lane deselection.

nodes.label: Base-Tip Rule Evaluation and Rule-Change Listing
nodes.norm_label: base-tip rule evaluation and rule-change listing
nodes.rationale: Reads modified rule sources from the base branch tip via git show (treating newly added rules as giving no permission) so a change cannot exempt itself; lists rule edits for human review rather than auto-blocking legitimate rule updates, while treating openspec/changes/<name>/ artifacts as working-tree intent.

nodes.label: Default Branch Base Resolution
nodes.rationale: Resolves refs/remotes/origin/HEAD via git symbolic-ref with fallback to main (and user override winning) so repositories with non-main default branches are diffed against the true target branch.

nodes.label: Finding Origin Assessment (Line Test and Cause Test)
nodes.norm_label: finding origin assessment (line test and cause test)
nodes.rationale: Applies line test then cause test so unchanged unsafe code newly exposed by a diff counts as introduced rather than pre-existing; defaults ambiguous cases to introduced, keeps load-bearing old defects visible as findings without blocking or padding, and adds origin as a mark beside leverage tiers in structure-review.

nodes.label: Commit and Working-Tree Stale Check
nodes.rationale: Records HEAD commit, git diff HEAD digest, and git status --porcelain digest (excluding .code-audit/ and .structure-review/) at review start and before output; marks stale instead of auto-restarting to avoid unbounded loops while workers edit the tree.

nodes.label: Two-Occurrence Rule Promotion Test
nodes.rationale: Requires a problem to occur in at least two changes and have a diff-visible trigger before structure-review proposes a new rule (with trigger, check, and sources), preventing premature rule bloat while keeping Nowhere as default.

nodes.label: Pre-Existing Finding Visibility and Verdict Exclusion
nodes.norm_label: pre-existing finding visibility and verdict exclusion
nodes.rationale: Keeps load-bearing pre-existing defects visible in findings and separate rendered sections while excluding them from request_changes verdicts and code-audit numeric scores.

nodes.label: Baseline Gate vs. Verify Skill Separation
nodes.norm_label: baseline gate vs. verify skill separation
nodes.rationale: Keeps the static/unit-test gate fast and CI-runnable while generating a four-part project verify skill (Start, Drive, Evidence, Pass) that exercises the real program without inventing undeclared commands, referenced from generated AGENTS.md for cross-tool discovery.

nodes.label: Baseline Three-Tier Check Cadence and Integration Lane Deselection
nodes.norm_label: baseline three-tier check cadence and integration lane deselection
nodes.rationale: Splits verification into fast commit hooks, local pre-push gate via pre-commit pre-push stage, and identical CI gate so CI is not the first check without slowing commits; adds -m 'not integration' to pytest addopts so the default gate needs no credentials while keeping the rules registry test.

nodes.label: Baseline AGENTS.md Verification Trailer Decision
nodes.rationale: Prompts the user explicitly (with no default) on whether commits carry Verified:/Unverified: trailers and writes either answer into generated AGENTS.md definition of done so tools can unambiguously follow project policy.

nodes.label: agent-write-guard Gate-Configuration Rule with Modes
nodes.rationale: Adds an implementer write rule for dedicated gate-config files (ruff.toml, mypy.ini, .importlinter, .pre-commit-config.yaml) controlled by userConfig.gateConfigMode (off, observe, enforce; default observe logging to transcript) so new guardrails can be measured before blocking, while excluding mixed files like pyproject.toml and Makefile.

nodes.label: Repository Project Verify Skill (.claude/skills/verify/)
nodes.rationale: Tracked in git via a .gitignore exception (while leaving other .claude/ files ignored) because Claude Code runs project verify skills before commits but does not run plugin skills; runs validate_repo.py, mod checks for touched mods, and flags agent preload live-run needs.

nodes.label: Defect Audit Trigger Signals
nodes.rationale: Triggers defect audit offers from five zero-tree-read facts already in tracking/plan/worker reports (unverified slice in a test-enabled project, uncovered scenario, trust boundary, retry/concurrency/cache logic, or >=2 fix rounds) so prompts stay high-signal and avoid alert fatigue.

nodes.label: Targeted code-audit Re-Review and Schema v2.3
nodes.norm_label: targeted code-audit re-review and schema v2.3
nodes.rationale: Avoids full re-audits by checking only earlier findings and the fix diff, classifying each finding into five states (fixed, partially-fixed, not-fixed, waived, superseded) using permitted verification runs rather than worker claims, and writing a new non-destructive v2.3 artifact (re_review field) while keeping full comparison mode intact.

nodes.label: Combined One-Line Closing Review Offer and Parallel Dispatch
nodes.norm_label: combined one-line closing review offer and parallel dispatch
nodes.rationale: Presents structure review and defect audit in one combined question after the close run passes, then dispatches selected reviewers in parallel on the same commit with no concurrent workers so neither result goes stale.

nodes.label: Four-Dimension Audit Focus and Partial Scoring
nodes.norm_label: four-dimension audit focus and partial scoring
nodes.rationale: Scopes in-loop code-audit to security, correctness, performance, and error handling (with score: null for unreviewed architecture/readability and overall divisor 6.5) so code-auditor and structure-reviewer do not duplicate or conflict on code shape.

nodes.label: Unified Fix Slice Set and Dual Re-Review Clearance
nodes.norm_label: unified fix slice set and dual re-review clearance
nodes.rationale: Waits for all selected reviewers, merges blocking structure and audit items into one conflict-free slice set, re-runs close checks then re-dispatches every selected reviewer (including previously approved ones on the fix diff), shares a 3-round cap across the change, and rejects stale audit clearances without incrementing the round count.

nodes.label: Build Close Run (Declared vs. Found Gate and Verify Skill)
nodes.norm_label: build close run (declared vs. found gate and verify skill)
nodes.rationale: Runs declared gates automatically, requires one-time user approval before running inferred/found gates (preventing destructive database/container test targets), runs command-verified scenarios, and executes a project verify skill once after the gate passes.

nodes.label: Flaky Test Detection and Dispute Channel
nodes.norm_label: flaky test detection and dispute channel
nodes.rationale: Bans retrying tests until green, skips, xfail, and sleeps; permits one confirming rerun by implementer to file a flaky dispute with both outputs, routed to test-author to fix root cause or delete and mark the scenario uncovered.

nodes.label: Gate Configuration Protection via Instruction and Diff Check
nodes.norm_label: gate configuration protection via instruction and diff check
nodes.rationale: Prevents implementers from weakening mixed or dedicated gate configs (pyproject.toml tool sections, ruff.toml, mypy.ini, .importlinter, .pre-commit-config.yaml, Makefile gate target, CI workflows) via worker instructions plus orchestrator git diff --name-only inspection, and ports the real-check rule to Codex and Cursor implementers.

nodes.label: Opt-In Git Verification Trailers (Verified / Unverified)
nodes.rationale: Writes queryable Verified: and Unverified: git trailers only when enabled by project instructions or user request so shared repos avoid unagreed history noise; always states trailer status and reason in the closing summary.

nodes.label: Property-Based and Oracle Differential Testing in test-author
nodes.norm_label: property-based and oracle differential testing in test-author
nodes.rationale: Generates deterministic fixed-seed property tests for four stated law kinds using only existing project dependencies, and carves a named-oracle exception in the anti-tautology rule for differential tests with normalized comparison and approved-difference test data.

nodes.label: Two-Level Fix Round Limit (3 Rounds / 3 Attempts) and Hand-Back
nodes.norm_label: two-level fix round limit (3 rounds / 3 attempts) and hand-back
nodes.rationale: Caps both orchestrator dispatches per slice and worker attempts per failing check at 3 (plus 3 closing review rounds), keeps per-round reports (-r2, -r3) for context continuity, records unverified slices explicitly, and structures hand-backs with five fixed items so users can decide without reading diffs.

nodes.label: Python Property-Based Testing (Hypothesis) and Flaky-Test Prohibition
nodes.norm_label: python property-based testing (hypothesis) and flaky-test prohibition
nodes.rationale: Pairs derandomized Hypothesis property tests for four law kinds with explicit edge cases, prohibits skip/xfail/sleep/rerun test workarounds (distinct from production retry rules), and isolates timing-dependent concurrency stress tests behind a stress marker.

nodes.label: Python Three-Tier Check Cadence and Marked Test Lanes
nodes.norm_label: python three-tier check cadence and marked test lanes
nodes.rationale: Replaces leaving slow checks to CI with fast commit hooks, local pre-push full gate (pre-commit pre-push stage using language: unsupported), and identical CI gate; configures pytest addopts with -m 'not integration and not stress' so default local gates need no credentials or timing assumptions.

nodes.label: Incremental Load Idempotency Check and dbt Invariant Naming
nodes.norm_label: incremental load idempotency check and dbt invariant naming
nodes.rationale: Verifies merge/incremental logic via a run-twice comparison on fixed dev input (or documents steps without claiming verified if no write access), and names candidate dbt invariants (grain, non-null keys, ranges, source parity) without adding unrequested files.

nodes.label: Bidirectional SQL Rewrite Comparison (Signed Union)
nodes.rationale: Replaces deduplicating except with standard-SQL signed union all + group by + having sum(side) <> 0 (reporting per-side counts) so row multiplicity regressions and nulls are caught across dialects, layered behind low-cost row-count/hash checks with explicit normalization and intended-difference filters.

nodes.label: Platform-Split Custom Agent Definitions
nodes.rationale: Splits custom agents into Claude Code and Cursor CLI variants so each platform receives supported frontmatter and behavior while keeping agents outside marketplace plugins.

nodes.label: Git-Backed Marketplace Catalogs
nodes.rationale: Allows Claude Code and Cursor CLI to register and update skill plugins directly from the repository Git URL without public marketplace submission, keeping both catalogs aligned and excluding in-progress and deprecated skills.

nodes.label: Replace Skill Install with Marketplaces Proposal
nodes.norm_label: replace skill install with marketplaces proposal
nodes.rationale: Decouples skill distribution from cloned checkouts and symlink scripts by using Git-backed Claude Code and Cursor CLI marketplaces while replacing Codex support with Cursor CLI.

nodes.label: Non-Destructive Legacy Skill Migration
nodes.rationale: Documents manual removal of legacy Claude Code and Codex skill symlinks without ever auto-deleting existing user files, symlinks, directories, or backups.

nodes.label: Skill Plugins Exclude Custom Agents
nodes.rationale: Keeps marketplace skill packages limited to skill directories while documenting custom-agent prerequisites separately.

nodes.label: Non-Destructive Per-Skill to Group Migration
nodes.rationale: Documents migrating from the eleven previous per-skill plugins to the craft, flow, and data group plugins without automatically removing existing user installations.

nodes.label: Allowed Catalog Plugin Sources (skills/<group> & Claude mods/<name>)
nodes.norm_label: allowed catalog plugin sources (skills/<group> & claude mods/<name>)
nodes.rationale: Permits catalog sources to resolve to a skill group directory or, in the Claude catalog only, a mod directory, while forbidding the repository root and agents/.

nodes.label: detect-secrets
nodes.rationale: Runs on every commit to prevent credentials from entering git history.

nodes.label: import-linter
nodes.rationale: Statically checks import graphs via uv run lint-imports without executing code, closing the architectural boundary gap Ruff cannot enforce; requires include_external_packages=true for external/stdlib forbidden contracts and an __init__.py in every contracted package.

nodes.label: mypy
nodes.rationale: Runs with strict=true and warn_unreachable=true against the uv-selected interpreter; scopes ignore_missing_imports per package rather than globally so real errors are not masked, and lets retrofitted repos ratchet up from disallow_untyped_defs=true.

nodes.label: pre-commit
nodes.rationale: Configures both pre-commit and pre-push hook types via default_install_hook_types, keeps fast hooks on commit via default_stages, runs local uv commands via language: unsupported (formerly system), and pins hook revs with pre-commit autoupdate.

nodes.label: pytest
nodes.rationale: Runs unit tests by default while excluding integration and stress lanes via addopts -m expression; --strict-markers turns marker typos into errors instead of silently unrun tests.

nodes.label: Ruff
nodes.rationale: Serves as both linter and formatter (replacing Black and isort via ruff format and I rules), infers target-version from project.requires-python, mechanically enforces E/W/F/I/N/UP/B/C4/SIM/RUF (plus optional S bandit), and requires per-line # noqa reasons instead of blanket ignores.

nodes.label: uv
nodes.rationale: Replaces pip, venv, and pip-tools with one tool and commits uv.lock so uv sync reproduces exact environments across machines; falls back to python -m venv with a pinned requirements.txt when uv is unavailable.

nodes.label: Baseline pyproject.toml Toolchain
nodes.rationale: Consolidates uv, Ruff, mypy, pytest, import-linter, and pre-commit into one pyproject.toml config so tools stay fast and non-overlapping; existing repository tooling config always takes precedence.

nodes.norm_label: root skill.md (how to apply these standards)

nodes.label: Forbidden Import Contract
nodes.rationale: Keeps external driver and cloud SDK types (such as boto3 and snowflake.connector) isolated inside the adapter layer by forbidding their import from core, models, and utils.

nodes.label: Hypothesis Repeatable Profiles
nodes.rationale: Registers repeatable (derandomize=True) as the default profile in conftest.py so quality gates do not flake without code changes, while a separate search profile (max_examples=1000) explores new inputs outside the gate to pin via @example.

nodes.label: Layered Architecture Contract
nodes.rationale: Orders packages top-to-bottom (main -> core -> io -> models) in a layers contract so each package may import only layers below it and nothing above.

nodes.label: Three-Tier Verification Gate
nodes.rationale: Splits checks into fast commit hooks (preventing bypasses), full pre-push local gate (preventing broken pushes), and identical unskippable CI gate; handles slow tests by moving them to marked pytest lanes rather than dropping tier 2.

nodes.label: Version Pinning Policy
nodes.rationale: Do not copy version numbers from reference files because copied versions are stale on the day they land; derive Python version from project.requires-python and resolve current releases with uv add and pre-commit autoupdate.

nodes.label: Atlassian CLI (acli) Mechanics
nodes.rationale: Uses explicit --fields on workitem view because defaults omit description and comments, and writes bodies to temp files via --description-file/--body-file to avoid shell-quoting and newline mangling.

nodes.label: Bug Ticket Structure
nodes.rationale: Captures broken or misbehaving functionality with What's happening, What should happen, How to reproduce, Impact, and Notes.

nodes.label: Spike Ticket Structure
nodes.rationale: Frames bounded investigation or research with Why we're looking at this, specific questions to answer, a concrete Deliverable, and a Timebox.

nodes.label: Task Ticket Structure
nodes.rationale: Structures a piece of work to do with optional Context, What to do, and Done when sections, omitting empty sections rather than adding filler.

nodes.label: Write Ticket Skill
nodes.rationale: Helps write Jira tickets and comments in plain, human-sounding language via the Atlassian CLI (acli) without generic AI writing tells or invented facts.

nodes.label: Single Machine-Wide acli Site Profile
nodes.rationale: acli keeps one active profile machine-wide rather than per session, so another shell can switch sites mid-task; always pass --site to avoid interactive hangs and check acli auth status before concluding a ticket is missing or unauthorized.

nodes.label: Create Mode
nodes.rationale: Files a new Jira ticket (Task, Bug, or Spike) after gathering project, type, and concrete summary, using only as much structure as needed, compressing long context threads, and showing a formatted draft for approval before creation.

nodes.label: Draft-from-Ticket Mode
nodes.rationale: Reads the ticket and latest comments via acli first, then asks 1 to 4 targeted questions to fill factual gaps before drafting a response.

nodes.label: Draft Polishing & Native Domain Jargon
nodes.rationale: Confidently fixes non-native grammar issues (articles, prepositions, tense, false friends) and upgrades phrasing to natural native wording and standard engineering jargon while preserving the author's tone.

nodes.label: Human Voice Guidelines
nodes.rationale: Avoids obvious AI writing tells (em/en dashes, corporate buzzwords, throat-clearing, forced triples, dressed-up 'is', negative parallelism, trailing '-ing' clauses, significance inflation) in favor of contractions, concrete specifics, thread tone matching, and a pre-draft self-audit.

nodes.label: Jira @mention Account ID Resolution
nodes.rationale: Plain @Name text does not trigger Jira notifications and acli has no user lookup command; resolve accountId from visible ticket JSON or a narrow JQL email search before asking the user or defaulting to plain text.

nodes.label: Open Question Pattern
nodes.rationale: Places direct asks to another person in a dedicated short section naming the person, question, and next action so asks are not buried in prose and readers immediately know whether action is needed.

nodes.label: Polish Mode
nodes.rationale: Cleans up grammar, clarity, and phrasing of a user-pasted rough draft while preserving their voice and skipping ticket lookup or up-front questions unless genuinely ambiguous.

nodes.label: Pre-Post Flagging (Don't Silently Fix)
nodes.rationale: Flags code/SQL typos, plain-text @mentions missing account IDs, contradictory facts, and ambiguous references in a short numbered list before posting because silent fixes risk posting inaccurate context only the user knows.

nodes.label: Respond Mode
nodes.rationale: Drafts and posts comments on existing Jira tickets in short, thread-matched shapes (status update, answering a question, handoff, pushback, investigation writeup), confirming facts before drafting because wrong facts stand out in brief replies.

nodes.label: Session-Context Mode
nodes.rationale: Reports work just completed in the current session onto a ticket by reading the ticket for audience expectations and confirming key facts with the user before drafting.

nodes.label: Agent Installer Contract
nodes.rationale: Provides scripts/install.sh and scripts/install-agents.sh with symlink-first installation, copy mode, timestamped backups for non-repo targets, selective installs, and non-destructive preservation of unselected agents.

nodes.label: Namespaced Agent Skill Preloads
nodes.rationale: Requires Claude Code agent preloads to use <group>:<skill-name> because bare names fail silently with only a debug-log warning while the agent still launches.

nodes.label: Multi-Platform Agent Variants
nodes.rationale: Maintains matching-name Claude Code (.md), Cursor CLI (.md), and Codex (.toml) definitions preserving the same role and safety intent with native controls.

nodes.label: Per-Mod Claude Code Plugin Packaging
nodes.rationale: Packages each mod under mods/<name>/ as an independent Claude Code-only plugin so users install or remove individual mods without affecting skill groups or Cursor/Codex catalogs.

nodes.label: Repository Structural Validation Command
nodes.rationale: Single offline read-only command reporting all catalog, skill-directory, agent-parity, preload-resolution, mod-catalog, and shell-syntax defects in one run.

nodes.label: Codex and Cursor Fallback Skill Installers
nodes.norm_label: codex and cursor fallback skill installers
nodes.rationale: Exposes shared skills/<group>/<name>/ sources into flat targets for Codex and fallback Cursor installs via symlink-first scripts without deleting legacy installations automatically.

nodes.label: Domain-Grouped Skill Plugins and Namespaced Invocation
nodes.norm_label: domain-grouped skill plugins and namespaced invocation
nodes.rationale: Distributes each domain group under skills/ as an aligned Git-backed plugin excluding custom agents and non-release dirs, making <group>:<skill-name> a public identifier where regrouping is a breaking change.

nodes.label: Non-Invasive Snowflake Query Capture and Agent Attribution
nodes.norm_label: non-invasive snowflake query capture and agent attribution
nodes.rationale: Observes mcp__snowflake-raw__sql_exec_tool calls across concurrent agents without mutating results, grouping up to 10 in-session queries by agent with expandable SQL and auto-opening pane.

nodes.label: Repository Scaffold Specification
nodes.rationale: Specifies README onboarding ordered Claude Code, Codex, then Cursor CLI, agent-facing repo guidance, CLAUDE.md user-change preservation rules, and baseline .gitignore.

nodes.label: Skill Authoring Specification
nodes.rationale: Establishes the skills/<group>/<skill-name>/SKILL.md directory contract, optional subdirectories, explicit catalog membership declaration, and docs/authoring.md guidance.

nodes.label: python-engineering-standards (Base Skill)
nodes.rationale: Base Python engineering standards governing style, typing, docstrings, logging, error handling, testing, SOLID, dependency injection, immutability, packaging, timezones, and module layout.

nodes.label: Python Data Analysis Standards
nodes.rationale: Additive Python coding standards for pandas, numpy, notebooks, dataframe transforms, statistical modeling, visualization, and analytical ETL that build on python-engineering-standards.

nodes.label: In-Progress Skills Directory
nodes.rationale: Staging area for skills under active development that are not ready to ship and may contain rough edges, breaking changes, or abandoned experiments.

nodes.label: Analytical Pipeline Structure
nodes.rationale: Adapts the base module layout for scheduled analytical pipelines into pure deterministic transforms (transforms.py), dependency-injected I/O (loaders.py), schema checks (validators.py), and an optional thin notebook driver.

nodes.label: Analytical Reproducibility
nodes.rationale: Guarantees repeatable analytical runs by seeding all randomness, recording as_of snapshot timestamps on SQL queries against mutable tables, pinning package versions via lockfiles against pandas minor behavior changes, and enforcing explicit timezones on every datetime.

nodes.label: Data Inspection Before Transformation
nodes.rationale: Requires inspecting shape, dtypes, null counts, descriptive stats, key distributions, duplicates, and deep memory footprint before transforming because incorrect input assumptions cause 90% of wrong transformation outputs.

nodes.label: Performance Patterns for Data Work
nodes.rationale: Scales pandas/numpy workloads via chunked reads, categorical dtypes for repeated strings, numpy arrays in hot inner loops instead of .iloc/.loc lookups, and Arrow-backed string dtypes in pandas 2+.

nodes.label: Notebook Discipline
nodes.rationale: Keeps notebooks inspectable and reproducible via one logical step per cell, factoring reusable logic into .py modules, top # parameters cells for papermill/Sagemaker/Dagster, Restart and run all checks, nbstripout pre-commit hooks, and never importing from notebooks.

nodes.label: Pandas Transform Patterns
nodes.rationale: Favors vectorized Boolean indexing/.query() over .apply(axis=1), parenthesized method chaining, .copy() at ingress for immutability, matching nullable dtypes on join keys, explicit per-column null handling, and .assign() to avoid SettingWithCopyWarning.

nodes.label: Validation & Data Contracts
nodes.rationale: Uses lightweight input/output schema validation (via pandera or assertion helpers like validate_input) and tiny-fixture contract tests to catch upstream schema drift immediately.

nodes.label: Visualization Standards
nodes.rationale: Requires labeled axes, titles, and units, consistent styling scoped via plt.style.context in library code (avoiding leaked matplotlib globals), log scales for >2 orders of magnitude, and explicit DPI (150+/300) with bbox_inches='tight'.

nodes.label: Install Script Discovery Exclusion
nodes.rationale: scripts/install.sh only scans one level deep inside skills/, keeping nested in-progress skills invisible to deployment.

nodes.label: Skill Graduation Workflow
nodes.rationale: Four-step lifecycle for developing a skill: author in skills/in-progress/<name>/SKILL.md, iterate until ready, move the directory up to skills/<name>/, and deploy via ./scripts/install.sh.

nodes.label: Import-Linter Architecture Contracts and Ratchet
nodes.rationale: Encodes layers, technology-owning forbidden contracts, and sibling independence in pyproject.toml, using ignore_imports with unmatched_ignore_imports_alerting=error as a one-way cleanup ratchet.

nodes.label: Rules Registry Integrity Test
nodes.rationale: Validates docs/rules.yaml in pytest by asserting unique ids, allowed keys (rejecting enforced_by), matching applies_to globs, and existing non-instruction-file ADR sources.

nodes.label: Caller-Facing Google Docstring Standard
nodes.rationale: Enforces Google-style docstring formatting in Ruff while requiring prose to document caller contracts and constraints missing from type signatures rather than repeating signatures or ADR rationales.

nodes.label: Architecture Baseline Skill
nodes.rationale: Converts a design doc into machine-enforced architectural constraints, real declaration files, ADRs, rules registry, AGENTS.md, verify skill, and docs/ARCHITECTURE.md before feature code exists.

nodes.label: Nygard ADR Format and Non-Bundling Rule
nodes.norm_label: nygard adr format and non-bundling rule
nodes.rationale: Records one decision per sequentially numbered Nygard ADR (0001-0007) during the conversation while alternatives are live so individual decisions can be superseded without losing historical trade-offs.

nodes.label: One-Way Dependency Flow Principle
nodes.rationale: Structures Data Pipeline, Service, CLI Tool, and Library archetypes so dependencies flow strictly entrypoint -> core -> {models, io, utils}, treating circular imports as layering errors and naming packages by responsibility.

nodes.label: Single-Home Rule Principle
nodes.rationale: Eliminates rule drift by giving each rule one home: tool config with ADR comment for checkable rules, docs/rules.yaml for uncheckable structural rules, AGENTS.md for conventions, and docs/ARCHITECTURE.md for reviewer orientation without stale inventory.

nodes.label: SQL Correctness Rules and Output Standard
nodes.norm_label: sql correctness rules and output standard
nodes.rationale: Validate join cardinality empirically, pre-aggregate one-to-many joins, handle NULLs intentionally (coalesce/nullif/is distinct from), use half-open intervals and union all, and format with lowercase keywords, leading commas, and pipeline-stage CTEs.

nodes.label: Data Marketplace Plugin README
nodes.rationale: Documents the data plugin (/data:<skill-name>) containing sql-data-analysis and data-governance, dual-catalog registration requirements, and why moving a skill out of data is a breaking rename.

nodes.norm_label: expensive sql patterns and rewrites reference

nodes.label: SQL Data Analysis Skill
nodes.rationale: Canonical analytical SQL standard across warehouses: correct first, then simplest, then cheapest; choose query shape based on artifact type and how the warehouse pays for it.

nodes.label: SQL Audit Correctness Traps (Fan-out and NULL Semantics)
nodes.norm_label: sql audit correctness traps (fan-out and null semantics)
nodes.rationale: Non-unique join fan-out silently multiplies rows and corrupts downstream aggregates, NOT IN subqueries containing NULL return zero rows, and WHERE filters on LEFT JOINed tables silently turn them into INNER JOINs.

nodes.label: SQL Scan Cost, Layering, and Rerun Idempotency
nodes.norm_label: sql scan cost, layering, and rerun idempotency
nodes.rationale: Missing partition-pruning predicates cap Performance <= 6, wrapped filter columns block pruning, declarative SQL uses staging-intermediate-mart layering instead of SOLID, and non-idempotent INSERTs double-count on reruns.

nodes.label: Anti-Join (NOT EXISTS) and Semi-Join (EXISTS) Rewrites
nodes.rationale: Replace LEFT JOIN ... IS NULL and NOT IN with NOT EXISTS (stops at first match and avoids NULL-induced empty results), and replace columnless INNER JOIN + DISTINCT with EXISTS so the semi-join cannot fan out.

nodes.label: DISTINCT Fan-out Masking and Everything-Except Negation Traps
nodes.norm_label: distinct fan-out masking and everything-except negation traps
nodes.rationale: Fix join grain rather than hiding row multiplication behind DISTINCT; rewrite long IS DISTINCT FROM OR chains into positive NOT EXISTS exclusions while verifying NULL retention semantics.

nodes.label: Eliminating OR Joins, Key Functions, and Repeated Scans
nodes.norm_label: eliminating or joins, key functions, and repeated scans
nodes.rationale: Normalize conditional join keys upstream to enable hash joins, replace date/cast wrappers with half-open ranges for partition pruning, and replace cross-joined MAX() or multi-CTE scans with metadata scalar subqueries or conditional aggregation.

nodes.label: Query Plan Verification (EXPLAIN) and Rewrite Equivalence
nodes.norm_label: query plan verification (explain) and rewrite equivalence
nodes.rationale: Run Snowflake EXPLAIN USING TABULAR before presenting non-trivial SQL to catch multi-scans, Cartesian joins, and pruning failures; verify rewrites bidirectionally counting duplicates because EXCEPT drops duplicate rows.

nodes.label: Claude code-auditor Receipt Contract
nodes.rationale: Returns a concise markdown receipt pointing to the .code-audit/ JSON artifact with verdict, score, blocking findings, base ref, origin counts, rule changes, and staleness so the orchestrator can gate without re-serializing findings or drifting from the JSON.

nodes.label: Claude pathfinder Compressed Briefing Contract
nodes.rationale: Compresses code, document, Jira, and Snowflake investigations into bounded structured sections with verbatim SQL, coverage tracking, and a confidence rubric to keep raw source transcripts out of the orchestrator's context.

nodes.label: Claude structure-reviewer Receipt Contract
nodes.rationale: Returns a pointer to the .structure-review/ markdown report with gate verdict, top leverage-ranked fix items, gate status, and Declarations with no check so unenforced project decisions surface immediately.

nodes.label: Namespaced Plugin Skill Identifiers
nodes.rationale: Claude Code prefixes plugin skills as <group>:<skill-name> without an opt-out, making group membership part of the public identifier so moving a skill between groups is a breaking rename requiring an OpenSpec change.

nodes.label: OpenSpec Tracked Change Policy
nodes.rationale: Mandates /opsx:propose, /opsx:apply, and /opsx:archive in openspec/changes/ for changes altering repo structure, install scripts, tooling, or the install contract.

nodes.label: Mod Verification Checks
nodes.rationale: Runs claude plugin validate, claude plugin test, and tsc -p for each touched mod; skips tsc when .claude-plugin/types/tsconfig.json has not been generated by an interactive --plugin-dir load.

nodes.label: agent-write-guard Mod
nodes.rationale: Optional Claude Code mod enforcing Edit/Write/NotebookEdit test-tree boundaries between implementer and test-author subagents plus a gate-configuration rule with gateConfigMode (observe, enforce, off); fails open if a Claude Code update breaks the mod API.

nodes.label: snowflake-query-panel Mod
nodes.rationale: Claude Code mod hooking mcp__snowflake-raw__sql_exec_tool to display the last 10 queries grouped by agent via /sql-panel in session-only state without adding tokens to the model context.

nodes.label: Claude implementer Test and Bookkeeping Boundary
nodes.norm_label: claude implementer test and bookkeeping boundary
nodes.rationale: Forbids editing test files (recording wrong tests under Disputed tests) and plan tracking artifacts (keeping tasks.md single-writer for parallel workers), enforces uv run and read-only git, and fails fast after 2 same or 3 total permission denials.

nodes.label: Claude researcher Quote Provenance and Exfiltration Guardrail
nodes.norm_label: claude researcher quote provenance and exfiltration guardrail
nodes.rationale: Requires labeling every quote as raw, extracted, or paraphrased so the orchestrator separates passthrough text from agent voice, bans secrets in URLs/queries as an exfiltration channel, and halts GitHub API calls on 403/404/429.

nodes.label: Claude test-author Seam-Only Testing and Triage Rules
nodes.norm_label: claude test-author seam-only testing and triage rules
nodes.rationale: Sorts scenarios into testable, command, manual, or blocked; drives tests strictly through named seams without inventing internal names so tests survive refactors; never edits production code, recording Needed production changes instead.

nodes.label: Model-Specific Prompting Rule
nodes.rationale: Requires reading the exact pinned model version's current prompting guide before authoring skills or agents, uses Sonnet for bounded workers and Opus for judgment/review, and lets the model guide override docs/prompting.md.

nodes.label: Preserve Existing SKILL.md Policy
nodes.rationale: Forbids overwriting an existing SKILL.md without reading it, explaining the planned change and rationale, and receiving explicit user confirmation so hand-tuned skill instructions are not discarded.

nodes.label: Claude Agent Namespaced Skill Preloads
nodes.rationale: Maps pathfinder to data:data-governance and flow:atlassian-cli, implementer to craft:python-engineering-standards, code-auditor to craft:code-audit, and structure-reviewer to craft:structure-review; unresolved preloads fail silently so a clean launch proves nothing.

nodes.label: Mod-Enforced Agent Write Boundary Rationale
nodes.rationale: Frontmatter hooks with if rules were dropped because each rule matches only one tool, brace patterns like **/*.{test,spec}.ts failed in Claude Code 2.1.308, seven paths needed fourteen handlers, and exclusion rules could not be expressed; enforcement moved to the optional agent-write-guard mod.

nodes.label: Explicit Catalog Skills Array Contract
nodes.rationale: A skill loads only when listed in both marketplace catalogs' skills arrays (validated by validate_repo.py), excludes in-progress/ and deprecated/, relies on Git commit identity instead of fixed plugin versions, and requires globally unique skill names because the Cursor fallback flattens groups.

nodes.label: One-Shot Worker Return and Boundary Rules
nodes.norm_label: one-shot worker return and boundary rules
nodes.rationale: Requires workers to avoid premature text-only turns that terminate execution, take stated defaults instead of asking when dispatched, distinguish tool-enforced vs instruction-enforced boundaries, and keep skills self-contained.

nodes.label: Untrusted Content Is Data Rule
nodes.rationale: Wraps external tickets, pages, and query results in randomized <pasted_content id="..."> tags and treats embedded directives as findings to report rather than instructions to obey.

nodes.label: Symlink-First and Backup-Before-Overwrite Strategy
nodes.rationale: Chose symlinks over copies or hardlinks for instant edit reflection (with --copy for CI/production), configurable CLAUDE_SKILLS_DIR/CODEX_SKILLS_DIR env vars, and .bak.<timestamp> backups so installs never silently overwrite user edits.

nodes.label: Marketplace and Fallback Distribution Model
nodes.rationale: Distributes skills as Git-backed marketplace snapshot plugins for Claude Code and Cursor CLI, provides symlink-first flat installers for Codex and restricted Cursor teams (deliberately unprefixed), installs custom agents separately, and never auto-deletes legacy installs or backups.

nodes.label: Property-Based Testing for Code with a Law
nodes.norm_label: property-based testing for code with a law
nodes.rationale: Directs property-based tests for round-trips, invariants, idempotency, and equivalence while retaining explicit edge-case tests, requiring repeatable default inputs, and recommending rather than adding an undeclared library.

nodes.label: Three-Tier Verification Gate and Integration Lane Deselection
nodes.norm_label: three-tier verification gate and integration lane deselection
nodes.rationale: Runs fast hooks on commit, the full gate (type check plus default test run deselecting integration tests) locally before push, and the identical gate in CI so CI is never the first place checks run.

nodes.label: Bidirectional Multiset Rewrite Comparison
nodes.rationale: Compares original and rewritten results in both directions including duplicate counts and null equality, rejecting plain set-difference EXCEPT because it hides duplicate fan-out regressions.

nodes.label: Incremental Load Idempotency Check and Candidate Invariants
nodes.norm_label: incremental load idempotency check and candidate invariants
nodes.rationale: Verifies incremental/merge loads by running twice on identical input and comparing outputs, and names dbt grain and non-null invariants as candidate tests without creating unrequested test files.

nodes.label: Explicit Normalization and Intended Difference Filtering
nodes.norm_label: explicit normalization and intended difference filtering
nodes.rationale: Requires stating column exclusions, float rounding, intended differences, compared input/partition filter, and low-cost pre-checks, reporting actual counts when executed or explicitly stating that the comparison did not run.

nodes.label: Python Testing Standards Spec Delta
nodes.rationale: Keeps Python test suites honest by enforcing property-based laws, deterministic default runs, root-cause fixes for flaky tests, integration lane separation, and local pre-push gate execution.

nodes.label: SQL Rewrite Validation Spec Delta
nodes.rationale: Defines how sql-data-analysis verifies row-level equivalence for rewritten queries, optimizations, and migrated models without falsely declaring unexecuted checks verified.

nodes.label: Standards Verification Rules Tasks
nodes.rationale: Tracks implementation and live verification of SQL rewrite comparison and Python testing/hook verification rules across skill references, SKILL.md files, READMEs, and catalogs.

nodes.rationale: Indexes the craft marketplace plugin skills (architecture-baseline, python-engineering-standards, code-audit, structure-review) and reminds contributors of dual-catalog registration and breaking group renames.

nodes.label: Flaky Test Fix-or-Delete Policy
nodes.rationale: Forbids skip, xfail, sleep, or automatic reruns to mask test flakiness, requires deleting unfixable flaky tests with a recorded reason, and isolates timing-dependent stress tests outside the default run.

nodes.label: Python Project Archetypes (Pipeline, Service, CLI)
nodes.rationale: Defines concrete directory trees for data pipelines (argparse main.py + io/ adapters), HTTP services (FastAPI/Flask api/ + pydantic-settings config.py + domain/wire models), and multi-command CLIs (click/typer cli.py).

nodes.label: Python Testing, Property-Based Tests, and No-Flake Policy
nodes.norm_label: python testing, property-based tests, and no-flake policy
nodes.rationale: Use pytest with injected fakes instead of deep patching, add Hypothesis property-based tests only for genuine laws when declared, and fix or delete flaky tests rather than masking them with sleeps, skips, or reruns.

nodes.label: Eight Structural Review Passes
nodes.rationale: Evaluates declaration/design conformance, module shape and placement, state ownership (leading-parameter ratio), duplication, test design, pattern fit (missing vs gratuitous), readability, and function-level Clean Code.

nodes.label: Python Engineering Standards Skill
nodes.rationale: Guiding principle: write code another engineer can read, test, and re-run six months from now without surprise; explicit checked-in project configuration takes precedence over skill defaults.

nodes.label: One-Way Dependency Flow (main/cli -> core -> models/io/utils)
nodes.rationale: Unidirectional imports keep utils/ testable with no setup, core/ testable with fakes, and models/ free of logic and I/O; circular imports signal a layering error rather than an import puzzle.

nodes.label: Code That Reads As Written (Anti-Slop Patterns)
nodes.norm_label: code that reads as written (anti-slop patterns)
nodes.rationale: Eliminate step-numbered headers, docstrings on tiny private helpers, defensive checks on non-failing internals, single-implementation abstractions, entry/exit logging ceremony, placeholder naming (utils.py/helpers.py), and unsolicited files.

nodes.label: Choosing a Class, Function, or Frozen Dataclass
nodes.norm_label: choosing a class, function, or frozen dataclass
nodes.rationale: Decide by state ownership rather than size: put shared state/resources in a class to avoid the parameter-threading smell, use free functions for stateless transforms, and use frozen dataclasses for value objects.

nodes.label: Comments, Docstrings, and Anti-Plan-Citation Rule
nodes.rationale: Scale documentation with public API surface using Google-style docstrings; never cite plan decision IDs or task numbers (D1, task 3.2) because those pointers break on archival and collide across modules—write the durable rationale instead.

nodes.rationale: Defines shared integrity rules across code-audit and structure-review for finding responsibility, rule immutability, commit binding, and lesson promotion.

nodes.label: Code Audit Skill
nodes.rationale: Read-only, language-agnostic code review producing structured JSON artifacts under ./.code-audit/ with language packs, base-version rule checking, origin tracking, and optional markdown rendering.

nodes.label: Base-Version Rule Judging and Rule Change Reporting
nodes.norm_label: base-version rule judging and rule change reporting
nodes.rationale: Prevents self-approving changes by judging edited rule sources against the repository default base branch and listing every added, edited, or deleted rule source for human review.

nodes.label: Two-Occurrence Lesson-to-Rule Promotion
nodes.rationale: Prevents rule bloat by allowing structure-review to propose a new rule only after at least two observed occurrences whose trigger can be read directly from a diff.

nodes.label: Two-Sweep Review and Execution Probes
nodes.rationale: Combines Sweep A unit coverage and Sweep B cross-unit runtime scenario tracing with idempotency/concurrency/resource-lifecycle probes and optional test or scratch-script execution to catch interaction bugs.

nodes.label: Low-Cost Large-Relation Checks
nodes.rationale: Uses row counts and Snowflake hash_agg fingerprints as cheap pre-checks on large relations; rejects bit_xor row-hash fingerprints because duplicated rows cancel in pairs.

nodes.label: Normalization and Intended Differences
nodes.rationale: Requires stating every column rounding or exclusion because unstated normalizations hide defects; intended behavior changes such as removing join fan-out must be excluded with an explicit predicate and matched against expected counts.

nodes.label: Incremental and Merge Idempotency Rerun Check
nodes.norm_label: incremental and merge idempotency rerun check
nodes.rationale: Runs a load in a dev schema, copies the target table, reruns on identical input, and compares copy vs target to catch non-idempotent additions or duplicate rows.

nodes.label: Runtime Operator Stats Follow-Up
nodes.rationale: Queries get_query_operator_stats(last_query_id()) when a logical plan looks clean to observe runtime row counts, exploding joins, remote storage spills, and pct_of_time bottlenecks.

nodes.label: Snowflake Plan Red Flags and Candidate Comparison
nodes.norm_label: snowflake plan red flags and candidate comparison
nodes.rationale: Flags high-cost plan patterns on large objects sized via partitionsTotal and bytesAssigned (repeated TableScan, CartesianJoin, non-equality joins, unpruned date filters, view-internal Sort, fan-out distinct Aggregate, unfiltered WindowFunction) while distinguishing benign view expansion and masking policy wrappers.

nodes.label: Signed Union-All Comparison Query
nodes.rationale: Uses union all with +1/-1 side markers and group by having sum(side) <> 0 so duplicate row counts are preserved and null keys cancel out without null-safe joins across SQL dialects that lack except all.

nodes.label: Explain Using Tabular
nodes.rationale: Compiles queries without consuming warehouse credits and outputs one row per plan operator for column-by-column inspection; avoids using json unless storing plans because nested JSON truncates in query tools.

nodes.label: Implementer Disputed Tests Channel

nodes.label: Scenario Triage and Public-Seam Testing

nodes.label: Agent Write Guard Mod Specification

nodes.label: orchestrate Skill
nodes.rationale: Drives bounded-plan builds by reserving the main session for judgment, review, and single-writer task tracking while delegating tests, implementation, and recon to fresh-context workers.

nodes.label: Flow Plugin Group Index
nodes.rationale: Indexes the flow marketplace plugin (/flow:<skill-name>) covering exploration, pressure-testing, delegated implementation, writing, ticketing, stashing, and Atlassian CLI usage; requires dual-catalog registration and warns that moving skills out of flow breaks agent preloads.

nodes.label: scout Skill
nodes.rationale: Conversational exploration skill that keeps the main session's working set small for thinking by delegating multi-file, ticket, warehouse, and web reading to pathfinder and researcher without implementing.

nodes.label: stash Skill
nodes.rationale: Parks raw conversations, pasted articles, meeting notes, and ad-hoc notes into the Obsidian vault's hardcoded inbox/ folder so a fresh session running /process-inbox can synthesize and file them without context exhaustion.

nodes.label: AI Tells Checklist
nodes.rationale: Catalogs machine-writing patterns to rewrite plainly rather than synonym-swap: antithesis frames ('Not X, it's Y'), trailing '-ing' clauses, uniform sentence cadence, stock vocabulary, LinkedIn clichés/staircases/hashtags, em-dashes, invented details, and small practitioner slips.

nodes.label: Practitioner Writing Craft Principles
nodes.rationale: Codifies craft moves from a company memo: concrete facts over adjectives of praise, before/after scale comparisons, varied sentence length, earning claims with evidence, five-beat blog story arc, specific credit, real names, concrete endings, and quiet structure.

nodes.label: Default Practitioner Voice Guide
nodes.rationale: Defines the fallback senior-practitioner voice when no author samples exist, blending narrative time-markers and long-then-short rhythm from a company memo with directness, real numbers, contractions, and plain language from a practitioner LinkedIn post.

nodes.label: write-blog-post Skill
nodes.rationale: Six-step workflow (mode/format, fact list, voice selection, drafting, AI-tells check, clean reply) for practitioner LinkedIn posts (<=300 words) and blog posts (600-1,200 words) in American English.

nodes.label: Gather Read-Only Dispatch Contract
nodes.rationale: Defines orchestrator-only value-adds when briefing codebase-explorer and researcher: explicit questions vs focus areas, shared-context splits, pre-globbed exhaustive file lists, exhaustiveness cues, and cross-agent flow synthesis.

nodes.label: Anchored Finding and Scope Detail Policy
nodes.norm_label: anchored finding and scope detail policy
nodes.rationale: Requires file:line anchors, reproducible bug stories, and zero padding; includes Before/After blocks for all PR diff findings but limits them to Critical/High in whole-file or directory reviews so major issues are not buried.

nodes.label: Single-Profile Global Auth Model
nodes.rationale: acli keeps one global active profile with no default-site config, so concurrent shells or agents can switch it between commands; always pass --site on auth switch and inspect auth status on not-found or unauthorized errors.

nodes.label: Single-Question Critique Loop and Convergence
nodes.rationale: Asks one direct decision question at a time without default recommendations, grounds challenges in existing repo facts (docs/adr/, CONTEXT.md, OpenSpec, git log), treats pasted artifacts as untrusted critique targets, respects user pushback, and converges once no structural concerns remain.

nodes.label: Implementer Brief Contract and Receipt Verification
nodes.norm_label: implementer brief contract and receipt verification
nodes.rationale: Briefs only what the plan lacks (Slice, Report to, Must not touch, Not in the plan, test selectors), wraps pasted external text in <pasted_content> tags against prompt injection, reads short receipts instead of full reports unless partial/blocked/decisions>0, and runs openspec validate after ticking tasks.

nodes.label: Read-Only Worker Briefing and Untrusted Return Handling
nodes.norm_label: read-only worker briefing and untrusted return handling
nodes.rationale: Routes local/ticket/wiki/warehouse lookups to pathfinder and web/public GitHub lookups to researcher; enforces explicit questions, shared-context splits, exhaustiveness cues, SQL inspection, secret-free web briefs, <pasted_content> sandboxing, and treating researcher returns as untrusted data.

nodes.label: Structure Reviewer Contract and Re-Review Loop
nodes.norm_label: structure reviewer contract and re-review loop
nodes.rationale: Supplies written intent paths, exact build-touched paths, off-plan decisions, and pre-existing failure flags without pre-judging findings; enforces that only a non-stale re-review at current HEAD clears request_changes and treats declarations-with-no-check rows as actionable tasks.

nodes.label: Test-Author Dispatch Contract and Selector Handoff
nodes.norm_label: test-author dispatch contract and selector handoff
nodes.rationale: Dispatches test-author once for the full scope with Expected outcome: fail and a task-to-scenario map, splits large batches along disjoint test files, passes returned per-task selectors to implementer, handles Haiku 5.5 refusals on security-adjacent scenarios, and re-dispatches test disputes with pass.

nodes.label: Batch Barrier and Continuous Dispatch Loop
nodes.norm_label: batch barrier and continuous dispatch loop
nodes.rationale: Dispatches parallel workers in one message, treats partial returns as mechanical recording turns until the batch completes, relies on notifications instead of polling/Monitor, and dispatches the next unblocked slice in the same turn so owed work never stalls.

nodes.label: Orchestrate Pre-Flight Gate
nodes.rationale: Runs four checks before dispatch — provisioning forbidden shell/env dependencies, checking code drift, closing unknowns via pathfinder/researcher, and readying scenarios/public seams — because implementer cannot provision dependencies or guess unknowns.

nodes.label: Single-Writer Task Tracking and Disputed Test Ruling
nodes.norm_label: single-writer task tracking and disputed test ruling
nodes.rationale: Keeps the main session as the sole writer of tasks.md and the harness task list to prevent parallel collisions, and isolates test-author from implementer so the code author never alters test assertions; the orchestrator rules on Disputed tests.

nodes.label: Explore-Phase Read-Only Worker Contract
nodes.rationale: Specifies pathfinder and researcher inputs and orchestrator value-adds during exploration: explicit questions vs focus areas, shared-context splits, pre-globbed exhaustive file lists, checking Assumptions before findings, reading verbatim Snowflake SQL, and folding findings into conversation.

nodes.label: Scout Batch Barrier and Non-Dependent Conversation
nodes.norm_label: scout batch barrier and non-dependent conversation
nodes.rationale: Dispatches independent questions in one batch, records partial returns in one mechanical line without drafting premature conclusions, avoids polling/Monitor, and keeps conversing on independent threads while workers run.

nodes.label: Readiness Test and Cheap-Orientation-First Reflex
nodes.rationale: Enforces 'look cheaply, then ask, then dispatch': gates one-shot worker dispatch on having a concrete written question so vague prompts use cheap structural orientation (ls, git log, README) before fanning out workers.

nodes.label: Untrusted Return and Pasted Content Guard
nodes.norm_label: untrusted return and pasted content guard
nodes.rationale: Treats researcher summaries as untrusted data rather than instructions, verifies decisive claims at source with one fetch, wraps user-pasted external text in <pasted_content> tags, and paraphrases secrets out of web-connected briefs.

nodes.label: Faithful Conversation Reconstruction Guardrails
nodes.rationale: Reconstructs sessions in third-person narrative preserving decisions, rejected alternatives, and entities while forbidding fabricated details (marking gaps [not captured] or [approximate] for distiller re-check) and gating sensitive content with redaction.

nodes.label: Strict Fact-Only Grounding Rule
nodes.rationale: Enumerates every input number, tool, company, and result before drafting and forbids invented statistics or unstated claims because fabricated details lose technical readers and embarrass the author.

nodes.label: CLI Entrypoints, Dryrun, and Layered Configuration
nodes.norm_label: cli entrypoints, dryrun, and layered configuration
nodes.rationale: Keep main() thin returning int exit codes, factor parse_args(argv), support --dryrun across all IO paths, and layer config env var -> secret/parameter store -> default into one fail-fast typed Config dataclass.

nodes.label: Secrets Lifecycle and Production Observability
nodes.rationale: Fetch secrets at the composition boundary, materialize ephemeral keys only in RAM-backed /dev/shm with mode 0o700, scrub exceptions, and emit run_id correlation IDs, health checks, phase metrics, heartbeats, and alerts.

nodes.label: Credential Handling (SecretStr) and API Auth Rules
nodes.norm_label: credential handling (secretstr) and api auth rules
nodes.rationale: Wrap credentials in SecretStr, never log secrets or pass them in GET query params or CLI args, use Authorization: Bearer headers, return API keys once and store hashed, and hash passwords with Argon2/bcrypt/scrypt.

nodes.label: Pipeline Idempotency, Streaming I/O, and Packaging
nodes.norm_label: pipeline idempotency, streaming i/o, and packaging
nodes.rationale: Make reruns safe via skip-if-exists, MERGE upserts, deterministic keys, and manifests over O(N) scans; stream large payloads with StreamingBody/multipart uploads; pin lockfiles and audit dependencies for CVEs.

nodes.label: SQL Artifact Cost Model and Query Contract
nodes.norm_label: sql artifact cost model and query contract
nodes.rationale: Views pay on every read, tables once per build, and dbt incrementals require stable unique_key, sargable is_incremental() filter, lookback window, and verified rerun idempotency; define grain, modeled-layer source, and data-justified guards upfront.

nodes.norm_label: declared group membership & catalog validation requirement

nodes.rationale: Uses only the plugin-namespaced identifier (e.g. craft:structure-review) to prevent double-injection for legacy installs, accepting that group membership becomes coupled to preloads.

nodes.label: Silent Bare-Name Agent Preload Defect
nodes.rationale: Claude Code namespaces plugin skills as <plugin>:<skill> with no opt-out; bare-name preloads in code-auditor, implementer, and structure-reviewer fail silently with only a debug-log warning.

nodes.label: Platform-Specific Agent Variants (agents/claude/ & agents/cursor/)
nodes.rationale: Separate complete agent definitions make native safety controls explicit (such as Cursor readonly: true vs Claude tool allowlists) without template build complexity.

nodes.label: Graceful Shutdown, Subprocess Pipes, and Connection Pooling
nodes.norm_label: graceful shutdown, subprocess pipes, and connection pooling
nodes.rationale: Handle SIGTERM via threading.Event to drain in-flight work, drain stdout/stderr concurrently to avoid 64KB pipe deadlocks, use process groups for kill propagation, and use driver connection pools or per-worker clients.

nodes.label: Synchronization Primitives, Bounded Queues, and Backpressure
nodes.norm_label: synchronization primitives, bounded queues, and backpressure
nodes.rationale: Avoid shared mutable state first; when sharing is necessary use Locks with global ordering, Semaphores, Events, and bounded queue.Queue(maxsize=N) with sentinel shutdown so slow consumers pace producers.

nodes.label: Python Concurrency Reference
nodes.rationale: Evaluate need, workload profile, primitive selection, and lifecycle/bounding before introducing concurrency; always predict expected speedup and measure.

nodes.label: JS/TS Async Footguns
nodes.rationale: Floating unawaited promises, forEach(async), and serial await inside loops cause unobserved failures or unnecessary I/O serialization; floating promises with unhandled rejections are rated at least High under Correctness.

nodes.label: Python Async Startup and Readiness Footguns
nodes.norm_label: python async startup and readiness footguns
nodes.rationale: Awaiting upstream calls before lifespan yield multiplies retry budgets by N*(R+1)*T and blocks service readiness when upstream is down; best-effort work belongs in an observed post-yield background task with bounded concurrency.

nodes.label: Concurrency Model Selection and CPython GIL
nodes.norm_label: concurrency model selection and cpython gil
nodes.rationale: CPython's GIL serializes pure-Python threads while releasing on blocking I/O and C extensions: use ThreadPoolExecutor for sync I/O, asyncio with TaskGroup and Semaphores for high-fan-out async I/O, and ProcessPoolExecutor with spawn for CPU-bound work.

nodes.label: JS/TS Security Checks
nodes.rationale: Flags eval/new Function/child_process.exec command injection, innerHTML/dangerouslySetInnerHTML XSS, client-bundled secrets (NEXT_PUBLIC_*/VITE_*), disabled TLS (rejectUnauthorized: false), and prototype pollution.

nodes.label: TypeScript Strictness and Trust Boundaries
nodes.rationale: Using strict mode, unknown plus narrowing instead of any, and avoiding unsound casts or non-null ! assertions at trust boundaries prevents hidden nullability and shape-mismatch bugs.

nodes.label: React Rendering Integrity and Composition
nodes.rationale: Compute derived state during render instead of mirroring via useEffect, avoid array-index keys on dynamic lists, sanitize dangerouslySetInnerHTML with DOMPurify, and split god components into custom hooks and presentational UI.

nodes.label: Code Audit Language Pack: JavaScript / TypeScript
nodes.norm_label: code audit language pack: javascript / typescript

nodes.label: React useEffect Dependencies, Stale Closures, and Cleanup
nodes.norm_label: react useeffect dependencies, stale closures, and cleanup
nodes.rationale: Missing effect dependencies, recreated non-memoized deps, missing cleanup or fetch abort on unmount, and stale closures cause memory leaks, out-of-order fetch races, and silent stale-state behavior.

nodes.norm_label: platform-ordered readme install section (claude code, codex, cursor cli)

nodes.label: CLAUDE.md User-Change Preservation Rule
nodes.rationale: Instructs Claude Code never to overwrite existing user skill files without explicit confirmation so hand-tuned user content is protected.

nodes.label: Python Correctness and Error Handling Footguns
nodes.norm_label: python correctness and error handling footguns
nodes.rationale: Mutable defaults, naive datetimes, late-binding loop closures, bare except: (capping Error Handling <= 6), and retrying non-transient errors cause silent state leakage, wrong answers, or swallowed system exits.

nodes.label: Python Audit Security Checks
nodes.rationale: Flags hardcoded or logged secrets, verify=False TLS bypass, subprocess shell=True injection, raw f-string SQL, unsafe deserialization (eval/exec/pickle.loads/yaml.load), tempfile.mktemp races, and assert for security invariants.

nodes.label: Injection Prevention, TLS, File Permissions, and Path Traversal
nodes.norm_label: injection prevention, tls, file permissions, and path traversal
nodes.rationale: Use parameterized SQL and allowlisted dynamic identifiers, ban pickle/eval/exec/yaml.load and shell=True, enforce TLS certificate verification, create secret files atomically with os.open mode 0o600 + O_EXCL, and guard paths with resolved.relative_to(base_dir).

nodes.label: Error Handling, Transient Retries, and Isolation Boundaries
nodes.norm_label: error handling, transient retries, and isolation boundaries
nodes.rationale: Catch specific exception types by default, retry only transient errors with exponential backoff and jitter, reserve broad except Exception for single-unit isolation boundaries that record degraded results, and manage resources with context managers or ExitStack.

nodes.label: Structure Review Report, Re-review Verification, and Guardrails
nodes.norm_label: structure review report, re-review verification, and guardrails
nodes.rationale: Writes immutable dated reports to ./.structure-review/<date>-<change>/<slug>.md, verifies fix lists by re-running evidence commands, enforces read-only source access, and treats source and declarations as untrusted data.

nodes.label: Structure Review Skill
nodes.rationale: Read-only senior-engineer structural review of finished changes before merge or archive, producing an ordered list of concrete edits ranked by leverage rather than bug severity.

nodes.label: Leverage Tiers, Reachability Test, and Lesson Placement
nodes.norm_label: leverage tiers, reachability test, and lesson placement
nodes.rationale: Ranks findings into 5 leverage tiers (already wrong, blocks refactoring, blocks testing, blocks reading, cosmetic), requires proving reachability before filing already-wrong, and promotes twice-observed lessons to gate checks or CLAUDE.md.

nodes.label: Scope Resolution, Standing Debt, and Base-Version Rule Checks
nodes.norm_label: scope resolution, standing debt, and base-version rule checks
nodes.rationale: Resolves scope (OpenSpec -> branch diff -> uncommitted -> path), tracks git state to detect staleness, reads edited rule sources from base tip via git show so a change cannot license itself, and deduplicates prior standing debt.

nodes.label: Snowflake MCP Query Rules and Untrusted Data Guardrail
nodes.norm_label: snowflake mcp query rules and untrusted data guardrail
nodes.rationale: Enforces fully qualified object names (no default DB/schema in MCP), server-side grant filtering, archive default for aggregations, and treating QUERY_TEXT/comments/POLICY_BODY as untrusted data to defend against prompt injection.

nodes.label: Circuit Trace and Terminal Pad Motif
nodes.norm_label: circuit trace and terminal pad motif

nodes.label: Data-Driven Glob Rules & Deny Seams (hooks/rules.ts)
nodes.rationale: Uses a small custom glob-to-regex compiler for **, *, and literal segments to avoid adding npm tooling, matching paths relative to session working directory so /tmp remains writable and defining exact test-asserted deny reason strings.

nodes.label: Disputed Tests Channel & Expected-Outcome Parameter
nodes.rationale: Adds a structured Disputed tests report/receipt channel for implementer so blocked tests do not weaken code, and makes expected outcome (fail or pass) a brief parameter so test-author stays source-agnostic for future backfills.

nodes.label: Preflight Missing-Variant Rejection
nodes.rationale: Rejects multi-platform installation before mutating any target directory when a selected agent lacks a definition for any selected platform.

nodes.label: Implementer Frontmatter PreToolUse if-Hook (Superseded)
nodes.rationale: Originally enforced implementer's test-tree boundary on Claude Code with 14 Edit/Write PreToolUse if-handlers exiting with code 2 to avoid jq or external script dependencies; later superseded by agent-write-guard mod.

nodes.label: Orchestrate Pre-Flight Gate & Dispute Arbitration
nodes.rationale: Checks that testable scenarios have named seams and settled asserted values before dispatching test-author with expected outcome fail, hands task-scoped selectors to implementers, and arbitrates disputed tests.

nodes.label: Inline Pane Lifecycle & /sql-panel Command
nodes.rationale: Designed for ~110-column non-fullscreen terminals: opens pane on first query with one session toast when isPlaced is false, registers unprefixed /sql-panel command to open at any width, keeps finished rows listed and expandable with full Snowflake query IDs because prefixes collide.

nodes.label: Add Mods Group & Snowflake Panel Proposal
nodes.norm_label: add mods group & snowflake panel proposal
nodes.rationale: Gives Claude Code function-hook mods a home in the repository and provides live visibility into Snowflake SQL run by the main session and subagents like pathfinder without scrolling transcripts.

nodes.label: Add agent-write-guard Mod Proposal
nodes.rationale: Removes the 14 PreToolUse frontmatter handlers from Claude implementer and supersedes archived add-test-author-agent Decisions 4 and 6 with a single tested Claude Code mod enforcing both agents' write boundaries.

nodes.label: Add test-author Agent Proposal
nodes.rationale: Separates test authoring from Sonnet implementer slices onto a dedicated Haiku test-author agent to reduce cost, eliminate spec-to-test drift observed in the snowflake panel change, and keep tests independent of implementation.

nodes.label: Call-Start Agent Label Resolution
nodes.rationale: Resolves and caches type plus name-or-description from $.agent.list() on first unseen agentId so finished subagents retain human-readable labels, falling back to main when absent and agent <first 6> when unlisted.

nodes.label: Functional Atom State Updates Keyed by tool_use_id
nodes.norm_label: functional atom state updates keyed by tool_use_id
nodes.rationale: Uses update($, rows, fn) keyed by tool_use_id with a cap of 10 by start order so concurrent out-of-order query completions cannot overwrite each other and evicted late completions are silently ignored.

nodes.label: Non-Interfering tool.call Recording Wrapper
nodes.rationale: Wraps next(e) in a finally block, parses MCP JSON defensively, measures end-to-end wait via $.clock, logs recording errors to debug via $.ui.log, and returns next(e) unchanged so UI bugs never fail agent queries and no warehouse queries like QUERY_HISTORY are issued.

nodes.label: One Plugin Per Mod Architecture
nodes.rationale: Each mod gets its own catalog entry under mods/<name>/ because hooks.json names one hooks module and separate entries allow installing mods independently; listed in Claude catalog only since Cursor and Codex lack the hooks-module engine.

nodes.label: Claude-Only Mod Catalog & Parity Contract
nodes.rationale: Each release-ready mods/<name>/ plugin appears once in the Claude catalog with a unique name; Cursor and Codex exclude mods and catalog parity covers skill groups only.

nodes.label: Optional Mod Replaces Frontmatter Hook
nodes.rationale: Claude frontmatter if-hooks allow only one rule per handler, one tool per rule, no brace globs, and cannot express negated production-code rules for test-author; replacing them with an optional mod removes enforcement plumbing from agent files and centralizes both boundaries in one unit-tested TypeScript rule set.

nodes.label: Stateless Fail-Open tool.call Guard
nodes.rationale: Subscribes tool.call on Edit, Write, and NotebookEdit without session state or types/index.d.ts, checks exact agent type via $.agent.list(), and fails open with debug logging and .catch so API changes never block unrelated file edits.

nodes.label: Named Public Seams Contract
nodes.rationale: Tests exercise only public seams named in the brief or plan (commands, entry points, hooks, tool names, IDs, output formats) and report missing seams or placeholder assertions as blocked rather than letting a cheap model invent module designs.

nodes.label: Prompt-Only test-author Production Boundary (Superseded)
nodes.rationale: Kept test-author's production-code boundary prompt-only because frontmatter if-fields cannot negate path patterns; later superseded on Claude Code by agent-write-guard mod.

nodes.label: Report-Based Task-to-Test Selector Map
nodes.rationale: Stores the task-to-command selector mapping in test-author's report instead of framework-specific markers or task IDs in test code, keeping tests language-neutral and free of ephemeral plan references.

nodes.label: Spec-First Single-Pass test-author Sequencing
nodes.rationale: Runs test-author once over the whole change before any implementer dispatch (optionally split by capability) to avoid per-slice overhead, cap the suite at roughly one test per scenario, and prevent tests from mirroring implementation internals.

nodes.label: Terraform IAM Over-Permission and iam:PassRole Escalation
nodes.norm_label: terraform iam over-permission and iam:passrole escalation
nodes.rationale: iam:PassRole on an application/task role or broad wildcard enables privilege escalation by passing a higher-privilege role to launched compute; open 0.0.0.0/0 admin ingress, hardcoded secrets, or *:* IAM policies cap Security <= 5.

nodes.label: Terraform ForceNew Replacement and count-vs-for_each Hazards
nodes.norm_label: terraform forcenew replacement and count-vs-for_each hazards
nodes.rationale: Changes to ForceNew attributes trigger destructive recreate of stateful resources, and count over lists causes index-shift destruction when middle elements are removed; prefer for_each over maps/sets.

nodes.label: Layer 1: Raw Source Tables (PROD_ENT_LOAD_DB / Estuary / Fivetran)
nodes.norm_label: layer 1: raw source tables (prod_ent_load_db / estuary / fivetran)
nodes.rationale: Ingestion tables that act as the source of truth for raw data tags and masking policies; raw schemas may carry versioned _V1 suffixes hidden from downstream layers.

nodes.label: Layer 2: Enterprise Views (PROD_ENT_DB)
nodes.rationale: Views reading Layer 1 raw tables with no independent tags; they inherit masking policies from the underlying raw tables.

nodes.label: Layer 3: dbt Prep / Source Objects (PROD_SOURCE_DB)
nodes.rationale: dbt models built on PROD_ENT_DB views with no tags of their own; masking reaches PROD_SOURCE_DB through the view chain from Layer 1.

nodes.label: Layer 4: Analytics Models (PROD_ANALYTICS_DB)
nodes.rationale: dbt analytics models materialized as independent tables that receive their own direct tag assignments and masking policies.

nodes.label: Four-Level Classification Scheme and Per-Schema Access-Role Ladder
nodes.norm_label: four-level classification scheme and per-schema access-role ladder
nodes.rationale: PUBLIC and INTERNAL return real values to readers; CONFIDENTIAL and RESTRICTED require inheriting per-schema database roles (<SCHEMA>_SCHEMA_RO -> _RO_CONFIDENTIAL -> _RO_RESTRICTED -> _RW).

nodes.label: SNOWFLAKE.ACCOUNT_USAGE.ACCESS_HISTORY View
nodes.rationale: Logs read, write, and DDL object access via ARRAY/OBJECT columns (BASE_OBJECTS_ACCESSED, DIRECT_OBJECTS_ACCESSED, POLICIES_REFERENCED, OBJECT_MODIFIED_BY_DDL); up to 3h latency, Enterprise Edition+, excludes failed queries.

nodes.label: SNOWFLAKE.ACCOUNT_USAGE.QUERY_HISTORY View
nodes.rationale: Logs executed SQL statements, execution status, error codes, bytes scanned, timings, and query hashes with up to 45m latency and 365-day retention; joins with ACCESS_HISTORY via QUERY_ID.

nodes.label: GOVERNANCE_DB.DATA_MASKING.DATA_CLASSIFICATIONS_MANUAL Table
nodes.rationale: Stores manual classification overrides with VALID_FROM/VALID_TO validity windows and REQUESTER_USER; inserting a row here declassifies an over-classified column on the next tag-applying run.

nodes.label: GOVERNANCE_DB.DATA_MASKING.DATA_CLASSIFICATIONS_TO_APPLY View
nodes.rationale: Final merged view consumed by the tag-applying procedure, resolving effective column classification in precedence order: metadata columns -> INTERNAL, active manual override -> MANUAL, auto -> AUTOMATIC, fallback -> CONFIDENTIAL (DEFAULT).

nodes.label: MASKING_POLICIES, ROW_ACCESS_POLICIES, and POLICY_REFERENCES Views
nodes.rationale: Expose dynamic data masking and row-access policy definitions (POLICY_BODY) and policy-to-object assignments including tag-based attribution and POLICY_STATUS conflict diagnostics.

nodes.label: TAGS, TAG_REFERENCES, and DATA_CLASSIFICATION_LATEST Views
nodes.rationale: Expose tag definitions, direct (non-inherited) tag assignments with APPLY_METHOD, and per-table JSON classification results in RESULT parsed via LATERAL FLATTEN.

nodes.label: SNOWFLAKE.ACCOUNT_USAGE.LOGIN_HISTORY View
nodes.rationale: Tracks login events, client IPs (0.0.0.0 for internal Snowsight/SPCS ops), MFA second factors, IS_SUCCESS, and error details with 2h latency and 365-day retention.

nodes.label: USERS, ROLES, GRANTS_TO_ROLES, and GRANTS_TO_USERS Views
nodes.norm_label: users, roles, grants_to_roles, and grants_to_users views
nodes.rationale: Track user accounts (MFA, lock, disabled status), account/database/application roles, privilege grants (filter DELETED_ON IS NULL for active grants), and user-to-role grants.

nodes.label: Column Classification Business Rules
nodes.rationale: Only CONFIDENTIAL and INTERNAL are actively assigned; unclassified columns default to CONFIDENTIAL via COALESCE(manual, auto, 'CONFIDENTIAL') as a safety net, while automatic classification is not yet live.

nodes.label: Governance Intent-to-View Mapping and Query Patterns
nodes.norm_label: governance intent-to-view mapping and query patterns
nodes.rationale: Maps real-time and historical governance questions to SHOW commands, ACCOUNT_USAGE views, and LATERAL FLATTEN parsing patterns for ACCESS_HISTORY and DATA_CLASSIFICATION_LATEST.

nodes.norm_label: code audit language pack: terraform / hcl

nodes.label: Snowflake Four-Layer Data Flow and Materialization Workflow
nodes.norm_label: snowflake four-layer data flow and materialization workflow

nodes.label: Snowflake Security and Access Control Views Reference
nodes.norm_label: snowflake security and access control views reference

nodes.label: Snowflake ACCOUNT_USAGE Data Governance Skill
nodes.rationale: Guides querying Snowflake governance views via Snowflake MCP (mcp__snowflake-raw__sql_exec_tool); Terraform is the source of truth for governance objects, so never recommend direct DDL changes.

nodes.label: Terraform Standing Audits (Whole-Config Checks)
nodes.rationale: Absent properties do not show up in diffs, so paths/repo reviews must enumerate every stateful resource for prevent_destroy/versioning/backups/encryption, walk the per-bucket S3 checklist, check ECR tag immutability, and sweep resources=["*"] wildcards.

nodes.label: Per-Database Role Scoping and View Masking Inheritance
nodes.norm_label: per-database role scoping and view masking inheritance
nodes.rationale: Database roles are scoped per-database; masking policies on Layer 1 evaluate IS_DATABASE_ROLE_IN_SESSION() and CURRENT_SCHEMA() in the raw load database context, so PROD_SOURCE_DB roles do not satisfy raw-table unmask checks.

nodes.label: Dynamic Policy CASE Evaluation and Datatype Sentinels
nodes.norm_label: dynamic policy case evaluation and datatype sentinels
nodes.rationale: Policies derive the required unmask role dynamically from CURRENT_SCHEMA() plus tag value with an INVALID_ROLE_NAME guard, returning datatype sentinels ('sanitized', -99999, '3000-12-01', or NULL for DATE/other types) when unauthorized.

nodes.label: Two-Layer Tag-Based Masking (DATA_PROTECTION_CLASSIFICATION)
nodes.rationale: 15 datatype-specific masking policies in GOVERNANCE_DB.DATA_MASKING are bound once in Terraform to DATA_PROTECTION_CLASSIFICATION; tagging any column automatically applies the matching datatype policy without attaching policies directly to columns.

nodes.label: Two Unmasking Levers (Declassify vs Grant Role)
nodes.norm_label: two unmasking levers (declassify vs grant role)
